protocol.conditions: One sequential diagnostic pass; CPU sampling and timeline stack capture add overhead. No pooling with formal release measurements.

existingRawAnalysis.observation: Source16 120-element late iterations become slower across different operations; 5000-element iteration9 contains simultaneous select/colour/palette spikes. This is temporal clustering, not evidence of a specific environmental cause.
existingRawAnalysis.environmentAttribution: CPU frequency, power policy, temperature and external process occupancy were not recorded; no causal environmental attribution is made.

attribution.finding: A tab change rebuilds unchanged main-canvas content and forces style/layout. The same path and cost are present in source10; this does not establish a new source16 regression cause.

attribution.sharedHotPath: showPane -> renderCanvas plus drawPalettes -> eight complete previews
attribution.finding: Eight real 5000-element previews retain 40000 SVG descendants and incur real clone/style/layout cost. No preview is omitted or replaced with a fake thumbnail.
Both phases rebuild property controls and repeat full-source clones for rich text, font targets and heatmap inspection. Geometry reads also force layout. These paths are unchanged from source10.

minimumRecommendation.candidate: Guarded reuse of the existing main canvas on ordinary inspector tab changes.
requiredGuards: Exact project/state/source/render context, selection, original/layout mode, zoom and viewport identity.
No active draft, pending asynchronous resource, temporary canvas paint or hover rendering; otherwise perform the canonical full render.
Retain all eight real palette previews, scientific colour semantics, full-render fallback and current canvas geometry.
minimumRecommendation.scope: A proposed bounded optimization for an evidenced shared cost. This read-only diagnostic does not implement it or claim its success. Complex selection-cache changes are deferred.

limitations: A single instrumented action per operation/condition supplies stack attribution, not P50/P95 or a new formal release comparison.
CPU self/inclusive samples and overlapping trace categories must not be summed as independent work; mark timing includes Playwright action preparation.
The original source16 formal regression evidence and all prior source09/10/candidate6 results remain unchanged. This diagnostic neither dismisses nor replaces those results.
